scope: Key-aligned local curves and real case variants; nominal digital prototype
review_integrity: All 19 frozen hashes matched after both first reports and before root edits. Workers reported no edits. Follow-up only re-emitted their reports; root edits are tracked separately.

findings.claim: La foto combina escalones de columnas, borde fino contrastante y transiciones locales. El generador ya deriva caras de pulgares, pero sustituye tres caras inferiores por una sola cúbica. Recuperar tramos alineados y unirlos localmente acerca la forma a las teclas sin moverlas.

Riesgo MEDIUM: aumentar uniformemente R0.8 falla en escalones cortos; existe uno de 2 mm. MARGIN=4.75 supera el mínimo analítico documentado de K32 solamente por 0.025 mm. El radio debe limitarse por longitud disponible y distancia real al cobre.

Actualmente la configuración intercambia frames, keycaps y baterías; faltan variantes de base/placa. Existen generación nativa, exportación y empaquetado STL reutilizables. Supongo conservación del stack LCD; copiar literalmente el controlador expuesto de la foto requeriría otra decisión.

recommendations: Conservar 36 transformaciones, bahía 24 mm, flancos x135/x25, montajes, imanes, hot-swap y silla para ambas baterías. Usar segmentos nativos línea/arco; radios por esquina y puentes explícitos donde mandan electrónica o cobre.
Foto: placa negra ligeramente retranqueada y base roja visible como borde continuo; cambia geometría real de placa y revela la base, sin añadir interfaces.
Suave: mismo contorno asociado a teclas, transiciones locales más redondeadas y borde exterior suavizado donde conserva pared y suelo.
Facetada: biseles exteriores y tramos planos orientados con los pulgares; mantener intactas superficies de apoyo, alojamientos y estaciones.

Añadir selección de carcasa por mitad, tarjetas renderizadas desde mallas exportadas, estado mixto explícito y persistencia JSON; aplicar la misma elección en FreeCAD, STEP/STL y GLB. Conservar controles existentes.

Aceptación futura: sólidos válidos, mallas cerradas, cobre real ≥0.5 mm incluyendo discretización, pared suficiente, ausencia de colisiones y transformaciones idénticas. Comprobar todas las variantes, ambas baterías y configuraciones calificadas.

Verificar controles mediante teclado y viewport estrecho; estados normal, carga, selección vacía y JSON inválido deben ser legibles y recuperables. Importación fallida conserva selección anterior. Un cambio únicamente cromático no acredita una variante geométrica.

Falsadores: radios sin longitud tangente disponible, pérdida de cobre/pared, interferencias o exportaciones que no reproducen la selección invalidan la propuesta dimensional; conservar entonces el contorno seguro y reducir el tratamiento exterior.

Aceptación geométrica y funcional del producto

findings.claim: Recommend a common key-aligned perimeter: retain column plateaus, restore three thumb-aligned faces and join them with short tangent blends. Use locally bounded radii instead of increasing every corner radius. This preserves the photo's stepped silhouette without its incompatible controller arrangement.
evidence: tools/build_revI_profiles.py uses MARGIN=4.75, R0.8 and one broad cubic replacing the south thumb faces; SHA256=76b429182df82cda33abedd7e85bb4ebb1bc6eb7271f5ccfdff0afc8319864e1.
Reference photo SHA256=edfccb01011c687655563935ed660ece09ef1c23e2c38ae771036238acda9dac; visibly thin red perimeter, black plate, local rounded transitions.

findings.claim: MEDIUM conditional risk: uniform slimming or larger inward fillets could consume copper clearance or short step segments. The source's 4.725 mm minimum leaves only 0.025 mm margin headroom; that calculation does not qualify every curved boundary.
evidence: The rounding helper requires tangent length below half both adjacent edges; one column step is only 2 mm.

findings.claim: MEDIUM implementation risk: existing choices switch electronics covers, batteries and keycaps only. Adding decorative cover themes would not satisfy actual case variants.
evidence: viewer/app.js applyConfiguration does not replace tray or plate geometry; SHA256=fd70750fdd617146a4297532505ccf46847ac76d5bc6e82a60d471f605fb68e4.
FreeCAD configuration.apply/extract currently serializes frames, batteries and keycaps.
export_revI.py validates every cover but currently exports one active tray/plate pair.

recommendations: Proceed with bounded implementation; retain the 24 mm bay, x135/x25 flank, all 36 transforms, mounts, magnets, hot-swap and shared dual-battery saddle.
Photo Line: black plate and red tray with an integral shallow perimeter shoulder; preserve structural wall thickness instead of narrowing the copper envelope.
Facet: chamfered exterior tray shoulder following the same key-aligned outline; avoid magnet pockets and screw posts.
Terrace: two shallow exterior wall steps following the columns and thumbs; keep the common cavity, floor and attachment interfaces.

Store case selection per half independently from frame selection; round-trip JSON through native FreeCAD links and export selected STEP/STL and matching GLB. Generate preview cards from those actual meshes.

Acceptance: every variant has valid connected solids, closed meshes, actual pad-to-edge clearance >=0.5 mm including cutouts, unchanged transforms/interfaces, and safe pressed-key envelopes. Verify exact selected mesh provenance, invalid-load atomicity, keyboard activation, mixed states, 320 px layout and retained viewer controls.

Confidence: high in source findings, moderate in geometry strategy. Falsifiers: insufficient local wall/copper space, failed native recomputation, incompatible key travel or export mismatch require reducing decorative depth/radius before accepting a variant.

consensus: Both source reviews recommended local tangent curves, preserved interfaces and actual interchangeable case geometry. No material objection to bounded implementation.

findings_disposition.FILLET_MARGIN: Global 4 mm slimming rejected: actual right-side K01/K02/K11/K21 pads fell outside. Retained 4.75 mm face allowance. Local radii bounded to available tangent length. Actual pad checks pass for both halves.
findings_disposition.CASE_CONFIGURATION_GAP: Three native base/plate pairs, different base volumes, valid connected solids and closed STL meshes. Per-half mixed choices and open covers passed FreeCAD save/reopen, legacy JSON normalization, invalid-load atomicity and exact selected GLB vertex checks.
findings_disposition.source_coordinates: Risk reviewer cited original Piantor source K32 (184,121,-25). Current immutable Filo36 coordinates remain (122,80,-25); layout hash preserved.
findings_disposition.variant_choice: Solid plus Color rim and Terrace. Both reviews agree on common-interface actual geometry; Terrace is the adversarial reviewer’s creative alternative.
findings_disposition.risk_handoff_schema: The risk report omitted schema_version and summary even after format-only re-emission. Runtime failed closed as FAILED; its independently delivered advisory findings remain preserved. No worker runtime COMPLETED or product acceptance claimed.

retrospective.trigger: User requests corners/curves aligned with keys like a Piantor reference and creative case alternatives.
retrospective.cause: A broad spline smoothed the thumb underside across multiple keys and small global R0.8 rounds remained visually boxy. Frame selection did not offer actual base variants.
retrospective.correction: Restore key-parallel thumb faces with local tangent arcs and native interchangeable base/plate geometry.
retrospective.prevention: Reject retained spanning-spline fixture; test actual right and left pads, local tangent joins, native variants, selected export identity and invalid configuration atomicity.

scratch_disposition.reason: Task-owned scratch/reference copies removed after canonical source and acceptance records were preserved. Original user photo untouched; no photo published.
